create_Dataset_from_anndata: create a Dataset from an AnnData object with perturbation, dose, and covariate keys for single-cell perturbation analysis
load_dataset_splits: load training, test, and OOD dataset splits from an AnnData file with specified perturbation and control keys
create_SubDataset_from_subset: create a SubDataset by calling subset on a Dataset with a split and condition to filter cells
convert_ranks_to_dataframe: convert an sc.tl.rank_genes_groups result stored in AnnData uns into a MultiIndex pandas DataFrame
check_adata_special_characters: check an AnnData object for underscore characters in specified fields and replace them with hyphens
